title: SuperPipeline decision.pulled_back
description: A held approval was pulled back before its release time, as request changes (charter 2026-11-09, an approval may wait for its release time §4). pulledBackBy is a principal id. Mirrors SuperPipeline's DecisionPulledBackBody (apps/api/src/board/views.ts). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

boardId.description: Null only on a board not yet initialised; a carrier needs it to route the event.

comment.description: Why, as the person wrote it; the board refuses a blank one.
